ja.title: Menin阻害剤のazole併用：公表PK/DDI情報から何を借りられるか
ja.summary: Revumenib・ziftomenibの公表PK/DDIとPBPKの用途を監査し、共同endpointの許容幅、倍率借用の不一致、AUCの機序的非識別性を調べた。クラス共通のazole倍率は正当化できない。
ja.seo_title: Menin阻害剤のazole併用：公表PK/DDI情報から何を借りられるか

en.title: Menin inhibitors with azoles: what can be borrowed from public PK and DDI evidence?
en.summary: A source-typed audit of revumenib and ziftomenib separates calibration, prediction and clinical evidence. Reduced-model calculations examine joint endpoint tolerances, cross-drug borrowing and mechanistic ambiguity without claiming independent clinical validation.
en.seo_title: Menin inhibitors and azoles: limits of PK borrowing
en.seo_description: Revumenib and ziftomenib labels, FDA reviews and PBPK results distinguish calibration, conditional predictions and limits of cross-drug DDI borrowing.
